newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Tubacex 9-mth profit up 131 pct.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Tubacex 9-mth profit up 131 pct.

text.p: Consolidated results for Spanish stainless steel tubing manufacturer Tubacex S.A. for the first nine months of 1996 to end-September (in billions of pesetas unless stated)
NOTE: The company said in a statement that it expected results for 1996 to exceed 3.0 billion pesetas.
The board of directors has agreed to reduce the company's share capital by seven percent via a reduction in the nominal value of shares to 93 pesetas from the current value of 100.
This will be effected via refunding shareholders the difference, and the company has called an extraordinary shareholder meeting on December 11 to put the proposal to a vote.
